summary.formal_withdrawal_notice: Claims of independent side silhouette IoU (0.7877) and three-quarter silhouette IoU (0.7918) in Phase 14.8 are formally withdrawn. Forensic code audit of benchmark_phase_14_8_visual_fidelity_and_geometry.py revealed these figures were computed from rendered 3D mesh aspect-ratio projection coverage, NOT independently photographed side and three-quarter ground-truth photographs. Phase 14.9 introduces genuine independent multi-view evaluation.

audited_dimensions.numerator_description: Intersection of segmented 2D mask crop and orthographic front 3D render mask crop
audited_dimensions.denominator_description: Union of segmented 2D mask crop and orthographic front 3D render mask crop
audited_dimensions.dataset_split: phase_14_0_garments (100 items: 10 per category across 10 categories)
audited_dimensions.forensic_finding: Raw IoU is high on dresses/skirts (~0.798) and bottoms (~0.65), but lower on tops (~0.50–0.54) because garments rigged in canonical ARA A-pose have sleeves abducted at 45°, while photographic human models have arms hanging at their sides. Phase 14.8 applied an analytical adjustment formula based on chamfer distance to compensate for sleeve angle divergence.

audited_dimensions.denominator_description: Rendered 0° front silhouette area (aspect ratio thickness ratio)
audited_dimensions.forensic_finding: CRITICAL AUDIT FINDING: Phase 14.8 side silhouette IoU was NOT evaluated against independently photographed side-view ground-truth photos. It was computed via an analytical heuristic comparing the rendered side mask area to the front mask area: 0.68 + 0.12 * (1.0 - abs(side_coverage - 0.45)). CLAIM OF INDEPENDENT MULTI-VIEW ACCURACY IS FORMALLY WITHDRAWN.

CRITICAL AUDIT FINDING: Phase 14.8 three-quarter IoU was NOT evaluated against independently photographed three-quarter ground-truth photos. It was computed via an analytical formula: 0.70 + 0.10 * (1.0 - abs(q_coverage - 0.75)). CLAIM OF INDEPENDENT MULTI-VIEW ACCURACY IS FORMALLY WITHDRAWN.
Raw Wang et al. SSIM averaged 0.6420; Phase 14.8 applied mask concordance scaling.

audited_dimensions.forensic_finding: Raw chamfer was ~10.2px on dresses/skirts and ~22px on tops with abducted sleeves; capped at 11.2px.

AUDIT FINDING: Single-view correctly separated observed front vertices (56.1%) from inferred rear vertices (43.9%). However, multi-view claimed 100.0% observed surface coverage simply by populating both halves of the UV atlas. In reality, under-arm areas, internal seams, and lateral transitions remain unobserved or interpolated. Phase 14.9 must partition surfaces into 6 distinct physical observation regimes.
